description: PolyBlog Blog Builder helps teams manage multilingual blogs from ChatGPT. Review blogs and article drafts, audit translation coverage, inspect public sitemap links, review topic ideas, and preview content before making changes. With confirmation, it can create, revise, publish, unpublish, or delete articles. Contacts, credentials, subscriber data, image generation, and autopilot are not included.

defaultPrompt: Show my PolyBlog blogs and open an overview of the first one.
Audit localization coverage for my first PolyBlog blog and show what is missing.
Review my newest draft and suggest a revision, but do not publish or change anything yet.
